decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ( D217-03s, wi-fi deployment project report received 26/11/13 ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 2 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.
Condition : 3 - In accordance with wi-fi deployment project report received 26/11/13 relevant access points shall be colour coded to match their setting.

Condition : 4 - All associated equipment is to be removed if no longer in operation, and any disruption to building fabric shall be made good to match its surroundings in materials, colour and texture within one month of the removal
description:
- Installation of wireless access points (colour matched) in ticket hall and platform.

- Installation of conduit (colour matched) from existing network sources to access points.
